manifest.name: @dsh-external/persona-driven
manifest.description: 人格驱动引擎（persona-driven）的 DeepSeek Harness 插件版：把「AI 太谨慎、小改动反复测试、烧 token」翻译成 8 颗可调旋钮，按 MBTI 类型或预设写入档位，并每轮注入。内置 persona-driven 技能（ctx.skills.registerProvider），用原生 Cordis 扩展点做每轮注入（agent/pre-step）与安全底线强制确认（tools/pre-execute → ask），不依赖 Bash，也不需要每轮起 Python 子进程；状态文件与 Python CLI（scripts/persona.py）完全共用，档位切换、看板与对照实验工具全部保留。上行来源：persona-driven 技能 v1.5.37。
manifest.//peerDependenciesMeta: DSH 的运行时解析器按 peerDependencies 判定「这个包可以引用安装体自带的包」。profile 内安装时包在 profiles/<name>/node_modules 之下，解析器会直接路由到安装体；用 link: 方式挂载时（开发态）必须声明这些 peer 才能解析。全部标 optional：profile 的 pnpm 配置是 autoInstallPeers: false，不需要也不应该由本包安装 DSH 自身的包。

bundle.text:
# @dsh-external/persona-driven 的 bundle 层。
#
# 本包声明了 package.json 的 `dsh.bundle.patch`，所以 DSH 的 plugin_manager 会把它
# 当作一个**可启停的 profile 层**（而不是「普通依赖」）。剖面把它加进
# dsh.profile.bundles 之后，装配时插入下面这一行。
#
# 这一行同时负责三件事，它们都在 lib/index.js 的 apply() 里完成：
#   1. 注册内置的 persona-driven 技能（模型在 <available_skills> 里看得到）；
#   2. 每轮注入档位块（agent/pre-step）；
#   3. 安全底线强制确认（tools/pre-execute 返回 ask）。
#
# 可选配置项（都有合理默认值，不写 config 就能用）：
#   config:
#     injectBlock: true          # 关掉每轮注入（技能仍然加载）
#     guard: true                # 关掉安全底线强制确认
#     guardScope: all            # all | exec（exec 只扫命令与路径，不再因写文档误弹）
#     metrics: true              # 关掉埋点写入
#     sessionStartInject: false  # 追加 agent/created 期注入（默认关：turn 1 已被 pre-step 覆盖）
#     webPanel: false            # 只读网页面板路由（默认关：slot 不传会话标识，会话层档位看不到）
#     skillDir: ''               # 覆盖技能负载目录
- insert:
    - id: persona-driven
      name: '@dsh-external/persona-driven'
      config: {}

readme.section: persona-driven · Persona-Driven Engine (DeepSeek Harness plugin)
readme.text:
> Turns "the AI is too cautious, re-tests every tiny change, burns tokens" into
> **eight adjustable dials**. One sentence — "be decisive" — switches the profile.
> This repository is the **native DeepSeek Harness port** of the `persona-driven` skill:
> a bundled skill, per-turn injection and a hard safety floor, all on native Cordis
> extension points. **No Git Bash, and no per-turn Python subprocess.**

readme.section: In 30 seconds
readme.text:
You do not need to know MBTI. MBTI is just a memorable handle; the dial values are what
actually take effect.

| You want | Just say |
|---|---|
| Go faster, stop over-testing | "be decisive", "stop re-testing everything", "too many tokens" |
| Name a type | "use ENTJ", "switch to ESFP" |
| Use a preset | "Fast mode", "use the steady one", "give me a few options" |
| Inspect / turn off | "what persona am I on", "turn off persona" |
| See your data | "persona dashboard" |

Eight dials, each 1–5:

readme.section: In 30 seconds
readme.text:
| Group | Dial | Answers |
|---|---|---|
| Execution | PACE | how often to stop and ask |
| Execution | **VERIFY** | **how much verification this change gets** |
| Execution | RISK | how much uncertainty is acceptable |
| Execution | STRUCT | whether existing structure may move |
| Cognition | DETAIL | how much detail to give |
| Cognition | EXPLORE | how many options to offer |
| Interaction | STYLE | how to talk |
| Interaction | WARMTH | attend to the person or the task first |

readme.section: In 30 seconds
readme.text:
Four presets — **Fast** (`P5/V4/R4/S4/D5/E1/ST3/W2`), **Steady**, **Explore**, **Companion** —
plus all 16 types. Eight domains (coding, UI design, visual image, finance, writing,
planning, collaboration, decision) each have a dial→output mapping; only the relevant one loads.

---

readme.section: Two floors that never come down
readme.text:
**Safety floor.** Deleting/overwriting, payments, auth and permissions, secrets and
credentials, production changes, destructive database statements, irreversible actions —
the profile always reverts to high verification and asks first. Once this plugin is
installed, that becomes a **real** approval prompt via `tools/pre-execute`
(not just the model's good intentions).

readme.section: Two floors that never come down
readme.text:
**Verification floor.** The profile tunes how much *extra* verification happens, never
*whether* anything is verified. Whatever you change gets verified; introducing new behaviour
or fixing a defect requires fixed, re-runnable evidence, self-reported on the last line.
It is **decoupled** from `EXPLORE` and `PACE` — "only one option" and "just be quick" are
never reasons to verify less.

readme.section: Two floors that never come down
readme.text:
> **Savings may only come from getting it right the first time**, never from doing less.
> A rework is treated as a signal that earlier verification was under-funded: catch up,
> do not keep skipping.

---

readme.section: Install — one command (installing the plugin *is* L3)
readme.text:
```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:yxdotnet/dsh-persona-driven
```

That single command installs the package **and** writes `@dsh-external/persona-driven`
into the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`; restart DSH and it is live. The same spec can be
pasted into the **Plugins** page in DSH's Web sidebar.

readme.section: Install — one command (installing the plugin *is* L3)
readme.text:
> Measured: pnpm finishes in 9.1 s; `dsh <profile> --dump-config` shows
> `- id: persona-driven` with zero warnings. Once published to npm, the equivalent is
> `add @dsh-external/persona-driven`.

readme.section: Install — one command (installing the plugin *is* L3)
readme.text:
> **No hooks to install.** On DSH the three capabilities — per-turn injection, safety-floor
> interception and telemetry — are carried by the plugin itself (native Cordis extension
> points). Once the plugin is installed there is **no hooks config file and no per-turn
> subprocess**; `~/.dsh/persona/` only ever contains `metrics/` and `sessions/`.
>
> It is the **plugin**, not the **skill directory**, that provides L3 — copying
> the skill directory alone gives you no injection and no guard.
> The hook bridge below exists only to keep older configs working — **not recommended**, ignore it
> for a fresh install.

readme.section: Degraded — without the plugin (L1/L2, **not an install option**)
readme.text:
Copy `skills/persona-driven/` into a DSH skill root; DSH discovers it automatically.

```powershell

readme.section: Windows PowerShell ($env:DSH_HOME defaults to ~/.dsh)
readme.text:
Copy-Item -Recurse -Force .\skills\persona-driven "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\skills\persona-driven"
```

```bash

readme.section: macOS / Linux
readme.text:
mkdir -p ~/.dsh/skills && cp -r skills/persona-driven ~/.dsh/skills/
```

DSH skill roots, lowest rank wins:

| Rank | Path | Scope |
|---|---|---|
| 100 | `<projectRoot>/.dsh/skills` | project |
| 200 | `<projectRoot>/.agents/skills` | project |
| 300 | `customSkillDirs` from the composition | configured |
| 400 | `$DSH_HOME/skills` | user |
| 500 | `~/.agents/skills` | user |
| 600 | bundled skill dir / `$DSH_BUNDLED_SKILL_DIR` | installation |

readme.section: macOS / Linux
readme.text:
`<projectRoot>` is the nearest ancestor containing `.git`.

**This level can influence, not constrain**: tone, detail and pace follow the profile,
but test depth is not enforced and the safety floor does not force a human confirmation.

readme.section: Install from a local directory (dev mode) — also L3
readme.text:
The plugin registers the skill, injects the dial block every turn, and turns the safety
floor into a real approval prompt.

```powershell

readme.section: replace <path-to-this-repo> with where you cloned it)
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <path-to-this-repo>

readme.section: then restart DSH — no hand-editing of the bundle list; the command above does it
Hook bridge (**not recommended**; kept for older configs only)
readme.text:
A compatibility path: generate a Claude Code-format `hooks.json` and let DSH's bundled
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code` bridge run it.

```bash
cd skills/persona-driven
python scripts/persona.py install-hooks                        # preview, writes nothing
python scripts/persona.py install-hooks --apply --write-confirmed
```

Then add the YAML the script prints into `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml` (or the profile's own)
and restart DSH:

readme.section: Hook bridge (**not recommended**; kept for older configs only)
readme.text:
```yaml
- insert:
    - id: persona-driven-hooks
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code'
      config:

**Pick one of A / B / C.** Options B and C both inject every turn; enabling both injects the
dial block twice (same content, pure token waste).

readme.section: Verify it actually works
readme.text:
```powershell
cd <path-to-this-repo>
npm test        # 273 assertions + install self-check (84 need a DSH node_modules; that suite reports "skipped, unverified" without one)
npm run doctor  # install self-check only
```

`npm run doctor` reports four things: package and patch integrity, skill payload
completeness, **whether the bundle is installed into any profile**, and whether the state
directory is writable. The criterion is "installed", not "the command exited 0".

Skill-side checks:

readme.section: Verify it actually works
readme.text:
```bash
cd skills/persona-driven
python scripts/persona.py doctor   # environment + DSH plugin + optional hook bridge
python scripts/persona.py get      # the effective profile and which layer it came from
```

readme.section: What this plugin does
readme.text:
| Item | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| Injection channel | `agent/pre-step` waterfall — native, no subprocess |
| Dependencies | **none** (Python is only needed for the CLI: switching dials, dashboard) |
| Safety floor | `tools/pre-execute` returns `{kind:'ask'}` → DSH Approval service |
| State root | `$DSH_HOME/persona` (default `~/.dsh/persona`) |
| Project layer | `<cwd>/.dsh/persona` — resolved to the git root, same as the plugin |
| Session id | `DSH_SESSION_ID` (older names still fall back) |
| Web panel | read-only status pill; **off by default** (see below, it cannot read the data) |
| Re-inject after compaction | **unsupported** (see below) |

readme.section: The web pill is off by default (it cannot read the data)
readme.text:
`lib/client.js` **is not enabled by default**. Not to save effort — it cannot obtain what it
is supposed to show:

- the host renders `conversation.composer.dock` with **empty props** (literally
  `renderSlot("conversation.composer.dock", {})` in the host source);
- the session id is not in the page URL, and the client exposes no injectable session
  service (only `slots` and the like).

readme.section: The web pill is off by default (it cannot read the data)
readme.text:
So the pill can only fetch without `?session=`, and the route falls back to the **global**
layer when no session id is given — but since v1.5.33 dials are written to the **session**
layer by default, the global layer is usually empty, so `persona` is null, the component
returns null, and **the pill never appears**. Measured:

readme.section: The web pill is off by default (it cannot read the data)
readme.text:
| Request | Response |
|---|---|
| no `?session=` (what the client does) | `{"layer":"global","persona":null}` |
| `?session=<this session>` | `{"layer":"session","persona":"ENTJ","dialsText":"P5/V3/R4/S2/D4/E2/ST4/W1"}` |

Turning on `webPanel: true` only makes sense when a **global** persona is set explicitly
(`set … --scope global`) — then the route reads the global layer and the pill is correct.
**Better off by default than shipping something that looks like it works and does not.**

readme.section: One real, minor regression: `PreCompact`
readme.text:
The upstream version registered five hook events. DSH's Claude Code bridge supports four:
`SessionStart`, `UserPromptSubmit`, `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`. **`PreCompact` is not
supported on DSH**, so it has been removed from the hook generator.

- With the **hook bridge**: after a context compaction the dial block is not re-injected.
- With the **native plugin**: unaffected — `agent/pre-step` runs every turn.

---

readme.section: Layout
readme.text:
```
package.json              DSH bundle manifest (dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client)
cordis.patch.yml          bundle layer: inserts the persona-driven row
icon.svg                  plugin icon
locale/{zh,en}.json       plugin panel title and description

---

readme.section: Requirements
readme.text:
- **Full access (DSH's Full access mode) — required.** The skill runs shell commands
  (`python scripts/persona.py …`) and writes **outside the session workspace** to
  `$DSH_HOME/persona/` (dials, metrics, session profiles). Without it, `set` / `off` /
  the dashboard / `doctor` fail on a denied write. The plugin removes the shell from
  **per-turn injection and the safety floor**, but these CLI operations still need it.
- **DSH** (needed for the plugin form; not needed when only copying the skill directory).
- **Node ≥ 20** (the plugin half; Node builtins only, zero npm dependencies).
- **Python ≥ 3.10** (only for `scripts/persona.py`; standard library only).
- ~~Git Bash~~ — **no longer required**.

readme.section: Requirements
Privacy
readme.text:
Metrics record tool names, classification flags, timestamps, the persona name and a
**hashed prefix** of the session id. They do **not** record command text or prompts by
default, and **nothing leaves the machine**. Data lives in `$DSH_HOME/persona/`.
`PERSONA_LOG_COMMANDS=1` is the single opt-in exception, off by default.

---

readme.section: Honest disclosure: the effect is unproven
readme.text:
The core hypothesis ("the profile reduces verification investment") has been tested in
three controlled rounds and **fails its pre-registered decision line**. The latest round,
v3 (300 runs = 10 tasks × 10 repetitions × 3 arms, single model):

readme.section: Honest disclosure: the effect is unproven
readme.text:
- median tool calls **12 → 7.5 (down 37.5%, 95% CI 27%–50%)**, direction holds and the
  dose-response is monotonic;
- **but missed verification degrades significantly** (C 79/100 vs control 48/100, p<0.0001),
  and the effect depends heavily on task type (21%–56%).

Therefore:

readme.section: Honest disclosure: the effect is unproven
Honest disclosure: the effect is unproven
readme.text:
The authoritative wording lives in `skills/persona-driven/references/limits.md` —
**all public claims must follow that file**. Two further limits must be stated alongside it:
**triggering is probabilistic** (measured: the same sentence twice, one hit one miss; naming a
type explicitly is far more reliable), and of the three floors only the **safety floor has
runtime enforcement** — the verification floor and "first time right" are written rules plus
per-turn injection, and depend on the model following them.

readme.section: 30 秒了解
readme.text:
不懂 MBTI 也能用。MBTI 只是好记好叫的外壳，真正生效的是旋钮数值。

| 想干的事 | 直接说 |
|---|---|
| 要快、别磨 | 「果断点」「别反复测试了」「token 烧太快」 |
| 点名人格 | 「用 ENTJ」「切到 ESFP」 |
| 用预设 | 「极速模式」「按稳的那套来」「多给我几个思路」 |
| 看 / 关 | 「现在是什么人格」「关掉人格」 |
| 看数据 | 「生成人格看板」 |

八颗旋钮，各 1–5 档：

readme.section: 30 秒了解
readme.text:
| 组 | 旋钮 | 回答的问题 |
|---|---|---|
| 执行 | PACE 推进节奏 | 多久停下来问一次 |
| 执行 | **VERIFY 验证强度** | **为这次改动投多少验证** |
| 执行 | RISK 风险偏好 | 愿意承担多大不确定性 |
| 执行 | STRUCT 结构约束 | 能不能动既有结构 |
| 认知 | DETAIL 细节粒度 | 说多细 |
| 认知 | EXPLORE 探索广度 | 给几个方案 |
| 交互 | STYLE 表达风格 | 怎么说话 |
| 交互 | WARMTH 共情温度 | 先照顾人还是先处理事 |

四个预设：**极速**（P5/V4/R4/S4/D5/E1/ST3/W2）、**稳妥**、**探索**、**倾听**。16 型全集同样支持。
八个领域（编码、界面设计、视觉图像、金融、写作、规划、协作、决策）各有一份档位→产出差异映射，按任务只加载相关的那一份。

---

readme.section: 两条底线，任何档位都不下降
readme.text:
**安全底线**：命中 删除/覆盖、支付与资金、鉴权与权限、密钥与凭据、生产环境变更、
数据库破坏性语句、不可逆操作 时，强制切回高验证并先问一次。
装了这个插件之后，这条由 `tools/pre-execute` **真的**转成一次人工确认（不是靠模型自觉）。

**验证下限**：档位调的是「额外验证」的多少，**不是「要不要验」**。改什么至少验什么；
引入新行为或修复缺陷时，证据要固化成可复跑的用例，并在收尾一行自报。
它与 `EXPLORE`、`PACE` **解耦**——「只给一个方案」「只求快」都不是少验的理由。

> **省下来的动作只能来自「一次到位」**，不能来自「少做事」。一旦返工，
> 即视为先前验证投入不足，必须**补齐验证**。

---

readme.section: 安装：一条命令（装插件即 L3）
readme.text:
```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:yxdotnet/dsh-persona-driven
```

这一条命令会**装包，并自动把 `@dsh-external/persona-driven` 写进该 profile 的
`dsh.profile.bundles`**，重启 DSH 即可生效。也可以在 DSH 的 Web 侧边栏 **Plugins** 页
粘贴同一个 spec。

> 实测：pnpm 9.1 秒完成；`dsh <profile> --dump-config` 里出现 `- id: persona-driven`
> 且零警告。发布到 npm 之后，等价写法是 `add @dsh-external/persona-driven`。

readme.section: 安装：一条命令（装插件即 L3）
readme.text:
> **不需要装任何钩子。** DSH 上「每轮注入 / 安全底线拦截 / 埋点」这三个能力的载体就是插件
> 本身（Cordis 原生扩展点），装完插件即具备：没有 hooks 配置文件，也没有每轮子进程，
> `~/.dsh/persona/` 下只会出现 `metrics/` 与 `sessions/`。
>
> **L3 来自插件，不是技能目录** —— 只复制技能目录不会有每轮注入与守卫。
> 下面的「兼容桥」只是兼容老配置的可选路径，**不推荐**，新装请直接忽略。

readme.section: 降级：不装插件时（L1/L2，**不是另一种安装方式**）
readme.text:
把 `skills/persona-driven/` 整个目录复制到 DSH 的技能根目录即可，DSH 会自动发现它：

```powershell

readme.section: Windows PowerShell（$env:DSH_HOME 缺省是 ~/.dsh）
readme.text:
Copy-Item -Recurse -Force .\skills\persona-driven "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\skills\persona-driven"
```

```bash

readme.section: macOS / Linux
readme.text:
mkdir -p ~/.dsh/skills && cp -r skills/persona-driven ~/.dsh/skills/
```

DSH 的技能根目录按优先级（数字小者胜）：

| 优先级 | 路径 | 作用范围 |
|---|---|---|
| 100 | `<项目根>/.dsh/skills` | 当前项目 |
| 200 | `<项目根>/.agents/skills` | 当前项目 |
| 300 | 组合里的 `customSkillDirs` | 由配置决定 |
| 400 | `$DSH_HOME/skills` | 本机用户 |
| 500 | `~/.agents/skills` | 本机用户 |
| 600 | 打包技能目录 / `$DSH_BUNDLED_SKILL_DIR` | 由安装体决定 |

`<项目根>` 是最近的含 `.git` 的祖先目录。

**这一级能影响、不能约束**：语气、详略、推进节奏按档位执行，但测试深度没有硬约束，
安全底线也不会强制转人工确认。

readme.section: 从本地目录装（开发态，同样是 L3）
readme.text:
插件会做三件事：注册技能、每轮注入档位块、把安全底线变成真实的人工确认。

```powershell

readme.section: 把 <本仓库目录> 换成你 clone 下来的实际路径）
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <本仓库目录>

readme.section: 然后重启 DSH —— 不需要手工改 bundle 列表，上面这条命令会自己加
兼容桥（仅为兼容老配置，**不推荐**）
readme.text:
插件之外还有一条兼容路径：生成一份 Claude Code 格式的 `hooks.json`，
交给 DSH 自带的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code` 桥接执行。

```bash
cd skills/persona-driven

readme.section: 兼容桥（仅为兼容老配置，**不推荐**）
readme.text:
**插件与兼容桥二选一即可，不要同时开**：两者都会每轮注入，
同时开会把档位块注入两次（内容相同，纯粹浪费 token）。

readme.section: 怎么确认它真的生效
readme.text:
```powershell
cd <本仓库目录>
npm test        # 273 条断言 + 安装自检（接线套件需 DSH node_modules，未配时如实报「跳过未验证」）
npm run doctor  # 只看安装自检
```

`npm run doctor` 会说清四件事：包与补丁是否齐全、技能负载是否完整、
**本包有没有装进某个 profile**、状态目录是否可写。判据是「装好了」而不是「命令跑完了」。

技能侧的体检：

```bash
cd skills/persona-driven
python scripts/persona.py doctor   # 环境 + DSH 插件 + 可选的钩子桥接
python scripts/persona.py get      # 当前生效的档位与它所在的层
```

---

readme.section: 这个插件做了什么
readme.text:
| 项目 | 做法 |
|---|---|
| 注入通道 | `agent/pre-step` 瀑布 —— 原生，无需子进程 |
| 依赖 | **无**（Python 只在用 CLI 切档、看板时需要） |
| 安全底线 | `tools/pre-execute` 返回 `{kind:'ask'}`，走 DSH 的 Approval 服务 |
| 状态目录 | `$DSH_HOME/persona`（缺省 `~/.dsh/persona`） |
| 项目层 | `<cwd>/.dsh/persona` —— 解析到 git 根，与插件读的同一处 |
| 会话标识 | `DSH_SESSION_ID`（保留旧名回退） |
| 网页面板 | 只读状态药丸；**默认关闭**（见下，取不到数据） |
| 压缩后重注入 | **不支持**（见下） |

readme.section: 网页面板默认关闭（取不到数据）
readme.text:
药丸 `lib/client.js` **默认不启用**。原因不是省事，是它拿不到该显示的东西：

- 宿主渲染 `conversation.composer.dock` 时传的是**空 props**（宿主源码里就是
  `renderSlot("conversation.composer.dock", {})`）；
- 会话标识不在页面 URL 里，客户端也没有可注入的 session 服务（`inject` 只有
  `slots` 这类）。

于是它只能不带 `?session=` 去拉数据，而路由在缺会话标识时退回**全局层** ——
但 v1.5.33 起档位默认写在**会话层**，全局层通常是空的，于是 `persona` 为 null、
药丸 `return null`，**永远不显示**。实测：

readme.section: 网页面板默认关闭（取不到数据）
readme.text:
| 调用 | 返回 |
|---|---|
| 不带 `?session=`（客户端就是这么调的） | `{"layer":"global","persona":null}` |
| `?session=<本会话>` | `{"layer":"session","persona":"ENTJ","dialsText":"P5/V3/R4/S2/D4/E2/ST4/W1"}` |

只有显式设了**全局**档位（`set … --scope 全局`）时，开 `webPanel: true` 才有意义 ——
那时路由读的正是全局层，药丸显示正确。**宁可默认关掉，也不留一个看着在工作、其实不工作的东西。**

readme.section: 一处真实的能力回退：`PreCompact`
readme.text:
上游版本注册了 5 个钩子事件。DSH 的 Claude Code 桥接只支持 4 个：
`SessionStart`、`UserPromptSubmit`、`PreToolUse`、`PostToolUse`。
**`PreCompact` 在 DSH 侧不受支持**，所以已从钩子生成器里删除。

- 走**兼容桥**：上下文压缩之后，档位块不再被重新注入。
- 走**原生插件**：不受影响——`agent/pre-step` 每一回合都在。

readme.section: 目录结构
readme.text:
```
package.json              DSH bundle manifest（dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client）
cordis.patch.yml          bundle 层：插入 persona-driven 这一行
icon.svg                  插件图标
locale/{zh,en}.json       插件面板的标题与描述

技能负载内部：

```
SKILL.md                     引擎：触发、旋钮、优先级契约、按需加载
assets/personas.json         唯一真相源：16 型 + 4 预设的档位数值
scripts/persona.py           状态机与 CLI（唯一读写入口）
scripts/hook_persona.py      钩子桥接的入口（兼容桥用）

readme.section: 依赖
readme.text:
- **完全权限（DSH 的 Full access）—— 必须**。技能要执行 shell 命令跑 Python 脚本，
  并写**会话工作区之外**的 `$DSH_HOME/persona/`（档位、埋点、会话档位）。
  缺权限时 `set` / `off` / 看板 / `doctor` 会因写入被拒而失败。装了插件后
  **每轮注入与安全底线不经过 shell**，但这些 CLI 操作仍然需要权限。
- **DSH**（插件形态需要；只复制技能目录则不需要）。
- **Node ≥ 20**（插件半边；只用 Node 内置模块，没有任何 npm 依赖）。
- **Python ≥ 3.10**（只有用 `scripts/persona.py` 这些 CLI 时才需要；仅标准库，不装第三方包）。
- ~~Git Bash~~ —— **不再需要**。

---

readme.section: 隐私
readme.text:
埋点仅记录工具名、分类标记、时间戳、人格名与会话 ID 的**哈希前缀**，
**默认不记录命令原文与提问内容**，**无网络上报**。数据存于本机 `$DSH_HOME/persona/`。
`PERSONA_LOG_COMMANDS=1` 是唯一的例外开关，默认关闭。

readme.section: 诚实声明：效果未经证实
readme.text:
本技能的核心假设（「档位能减少验证投入」）已跑过三轮对照实验，**按判定线不成立**。
最新一轮 v3（300 轮 = 10 任务 × 10 重复 × 3 组，单一模型）：

- 工具调用中位数 **12 → 7.5（下降 37.5%，95%CI 27%~50%）**，方向成立、剂量-反应单调；
- **但漏验证显著劣化**（C 79/100 vs 对照 48/100，p<0.0001），且效应强烈依赖任务类型（21%~56%）。

因此：

- **不要相信任何 token 降幅数字**；
- **不得宣称「已解决漏验证」或「机制有效」**；
- 分项数据可以如实披露，但**必须同时注明整体判定不成立**。

readme.section: 诚实声明：效果未经证实
readme.text:
完整口径见 `skills/persona-driven/references/limits.md`——**对外说明与效果宣称一律以该文件为准**。
另外两条同样要如实说明的限制：**触发是概率性的**（同一句话连说两次，实测一次触发一次没有，
显式点名稳定得多）；**核心假设的三条底线里，只有安全底线有运行时强制力**，
验证下限与「一次到位」是书面规则 + 每轮注入，依赖模型遵守。
